result.Method of Attack: Backdoored VS Code extensions embedding malicious functionality within legitimate features; Multi-stage infection chains with obfuscated payloads including one hidden in an image file on Internet Archive; Deploys malicious browser extension and portable executable (PE) for persistence and data exfiltration
result.Impacted Systems: Windows systems used by Solidity developers
result.Attack Vector: Malicious VS Code extensions masquerading as legitimate Solidity-related tools; Use of C2 domains resembling legitimate Solidity resources
